# AUS Business School

> AUS Business School, legally the American Institute of Applied Sciences in Switzerland, is an international business school in La Tour-de-Peilz, Canton of Vaud, Switzerland. AUS provides practice-led applied business education in English.

Canonical website: https://www.aus.swiss/

## Institution

- [About AUS](https://www.aus.swiss/about-us): Mission, values and educational approach.
- [Accreditation and recognition](https://www.aus.swiss/accreditation): Institutional accreditation, recognition and memberships.
- [Rankings and recognition](https://www.aus.swiss/rankings): Rankings and QS Stars information.
- [Faculty](https://www.aus.swiss/faculty): Academic faculty and teaching expertise.
- [Leadership and governance](https://www.aus.swiss/governance): Institutional leadership and oversight.
- [Policies and procedures](https://www.aus.swiss/policies): Official academic, student and institutional policies.

## Study at AUS

- [Programs overview](https://www.aus.swiss/programs): Five BBA specializations and five MBA specializations.
- [BBA Specialization in Aviation Business & Airport Operations](https://www.aus.swiss/bachelors-degree/aviation-business-airport-operations): Aviation business and airport operations.
- [BBA Specialization in Business Analytics & AI Applications](https://www.aus.swiss/bachelors-degree/business-analytics-ai-applications): Business analytics and AI applications.
- [BBA Specialization in Finance, FinTech & Digital Banking](https://www.aus.swiss/bachelors-degree/finance-fintech-digital-banking): Finance, FinTech and digital banking.
- [BBA Specialization in International Business, Trade & Supply Chain](https://www.aus.swiss/bachelors-degree/international-business-trade-supply-chain): International business, trade and supply chain.
- [BBA Specialization in Entrepreneurship, Innovation & Family Business](https://www.aus.swiss/bachelors-degree/entrepreneurship-innovation-family-business): Entrepreneurship, innovation and family business.
- [MBA Specialization in Aviation Strategy, Sustainability & Leadership](https://www.aus.swiss/masters-degree/aviation-strategy-sustainability-leadership): Aviation strategy, sustainability and leadership.
- [MBA Specialization in AI Strategy & Digital Transformation](https://www.aus.swiss/masters-degree/ai-strategy-digital-transformation): AI strategy and digital transformation.
- [MBA Specialization in Financial Strategy, Investment & FinTech](https://www.aus.swiss/masters-degree/financial-strategy-investment-fintech): Financial strategy, investment and FinTech.
- [MBA Specialization in Global Strategy, Risk & Supply Chain Leadership](https://www.aus.swiss/masters-degree/global-strategy-risk-supply-chain-leadership): Global strategy, risk and supply chain leadership.
- [MBA Specialization in Innovation, Growth & Family Enterprise Leadership](https://www.aus.swiss/masters-degree/innovation-growth-family-enterprise-leadership): Innovation, growth and family enterprise leadership.

- [Study business in Switzerland](https://www.aus.swiss/study-in-switzerland): Discover applied business education and student life at AUS Business School on Lake Geneva, and contact admissions for current study information.
- [GI Bill study in Switzerland for U.S. veterans](https://www.aus.swiss/veterans-study-in-switzerland): Eligible U.S. veterans can learn how Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits may support approved study at AUS in Switzerland and contact the admissions team for guidance.

## Admissions and student information

- [Admissions and financing](https://www.aus.swiss/admissions-financing): Application process, requirements, deadlines, financing and visa guidance.
- [Campus facilities](https://www.aus.swiss/campus-facilities): Classrooms, conference rooms, student spaces and nearby sports facilities in La Tour-de-Peilz.
- [Tuition fees and scholarships](https://www.aus.swiss/tuition-fees-scholarships): Scholarship information and guidance on obtaining the latest approved tuition details.
- [International students](https://www.aus.swiss/international-students): Visa, permit and arrival guidance.
- [Student life](https://www.aus.swiss/student-life): Campus, housing, activities and life in Switzerland.
- [Careers and outcomes](https://www.aus.swiss/careers-outcomes): Career services, internships, employers and graduate outcomes.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.aus.swiss/faq): Answers about admissions, fees, visas, housing and registration.

## Contact and location

- [Contact AUS](https://www.aus.swiss/contact-us): Email, telephone, working hours, advising, campus visits and directions.

AUS Business School is located at Chemin du Levant 5, 1814 La Tour-de-Peilz, Switzerland. Telephone: +41 21 944 95 01. Email: info@aus.swiss.
